title: Light Turkish Leek Stir-fry
description: A paleo-friendly, umami-rich stir-fry with tender leeks, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. This dish showcases the gentle flavor of Turkish cuisine.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped garlic and saut88 until fragrant.
Add the sliced leeks and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth, turmeric, and paprika. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the leeks are tender, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and crumbled feta cheese, if desired.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios for added crunch, if desired.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and pistachios if desired.
